description: This file defines the 'SummaryDisplayField' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, using Doctrine ORM annotations to map it to the 'ohrm_summary_display_field' database table. It specifies various properties related to display fields in summaries, including labels, sorting, element types, and relationships to other entities.

classes.name: SummaryDisplayField
classes.description: Entity class representing a display field in summary reports, including properties for database mapping, relationships, and display configuration.
